adjudication.reasoning: 'I will raise up for them a renowned branch' (germen nominatum) belongs to the same family of post-exilic Branch/germen prophecies as the existing members (Zech 6:12, Isa 4:2, Isa 11:1) — the texts whose proximate referent the tradition saw in Zorobabel as figure of Christ. The branch is named in the text itself.
